from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A person or entity involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="The full name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str = Field(description="The role of the party, e.g., 'Appellant', 'Applicant', 'Defendant', 'Respondent'")

class Outcome(BaseModel):
    """The legal disposition or decision regarding the case."""
    decision_type: str = Field(description="The core decision type, e.g., '驳回上诉', '准许撤回', '维持原判'")
    full_text: Optional[str] = Field(description="The full verdict text snippet if available")

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """A case number or specific ID referenced in the document."""
    number: Optional[str] = Field(description="The case number if mentioned")
    court: Optional[str] = Field(description="The court name if mentioned in the case context")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Financial details regarding court fees."""
    amount: Optional[str] = Field(description="The fee amount as written")
    fee_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="The fee type, e.g., '二审案件受理费', '一审受理费'")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who bears the fee")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema for extracting information from a single legal document."""
    parties: List[Party] = Field(description="List of parties involved in the case")
    outcomes: List[Outcome] = Field(description="List of outcomes or dispositions rendered")
    case_identifiers: List[CaseIdentifier] = Field(description="List of case numbers and associated courts")
    fees: List[Fee] = Field(description="List of fee details mentioned")
